bugs.title: Reclaim stale bot task labels (cleanup.yml) fails with JSON parse error caused by a trailing comma left after JSONC comment-stripping
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep prompt. Root cause per prompt: scripts/reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs kvNamespaceId() strips block+line comments from bot/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc then JSON.parse fails at position 534 line 31 col 1 because a trailing comma remains after the 'triggers' object with nothing following it before the closing brace. Fixes required: (1) remove that trailing comma in bot/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc (and bot/wrangler.bot-b.jsonc if same pattern), (2) make kvNamespaceId() (and any other scripts/ file parsing .jsonc the same way) robust to JSONC trailing commas — either strip trailing commas before } or ] or use an already-available JSONC parser (check package.json first, avoid adding new deps), (3) add a test/assertion that both wrangler .jsonc files parse successfully via that helper, (4) verify script runs end-to-end (at minimum kvNamespaceId() no longer throws). | in_progress: confirmed trailing comma on line 25 after 'triggers' object with only comment lines (blanked by stripper) between it and closing brace on line 31 — matches reproduction. Starting fixes. | DONE (commit 895eace): (1) Removed trailing comma after 'triggers' in bot/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc; bot/wrangler.bot-b.jsonc already clean (verified line-by-line). (2) Extracted JSONC parsing to scripts/jsonc.mjs (new module) and hardened it with a third replace step that strips ',' followed by whitespace/newlines before ']' or '}'. Confirmed no jsonc-parser dep exists (checked bot/package.json + no root package.json + only _legacy has an unrelated pkg); no new npm dep added. scripts/reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs now imports parseWranglerJsonc from that module; CLI env-guard behavior unchanged. Grepped scripts/ for other 'wrangler.*jsonc' or 'replace(/\/\*' — only reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs was affected. (3) Added bot/test/wrangler-jsonc-parse.test.mjs — 5 tests, all pass under bot's existing `node --test 'test/*.mjs'` runner (npm test 127/127 total pass). Test asserts both real wrangler files parse, the exact outage shape parses (and also verifies the PRE-FIX parser shape still fails on that shape), nested trailing commas parse, and line-number preservation. (4) Verified end-to-end: reproduced the literal `Expected double-quoted property name in JSON at position 534 (line 31 column 1)` failure with the pre-fix regexes on the pre-fix file; ran `REPO=motionssalt/clipforge node scripts/reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs` post-fix and confirmed kvNamespaceId() no longer throws — the script now proceeds to `wrangler kv key list` and fails at the expected downstream point (missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in this sandbox), not at JSON parse. Confidence: high.

bugs.title: Shadow Clones should not attempt to deploy a Cloudflare Worker — skip deploy-bots.yml deploy steps entirely on clones
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep prompt. .github/workflows/deploy-bots.yml currently runs wrangler deploy on every clone push touching bot/**, which fails loudly because clones have no CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/ACCOUNT_ID and are not supposed to run their own Bot A/B Worker at all (clones share the central Bot A per §10). Fix by gating deploy jobs/steps with `if: github.repository == 'motionssalt/clipforge'` (same pattern as news-push.yml). Keep bot test suite (npm ci / npm test) running on all repos including clones. Reconsider bug-58/bug-68 failure-alert step — if deploy step no longer runs on clones, alert has nothing to fire on and can also be gated to central repo (verify no other step on clones can still fail in a way this alert must catch). Do not change central-repo behavior. Verify: on a clone, tests run + deploy shown as skipped in Actions UI + no Telegram deploy-blocked alert. | in_progress: starting investigation of deploy-bots.yml current structure and the news-push.yml gating pattern to mirror.
